Surds & Indices, Logarithm, Odd man out.question:
১) Find out the wrong number in the given sequence of numbers.(1-5)
8, 13, 21, 32, 47, 63, 83
Surds & Indices, Logarithm, Odd man out.exp: Go on adding 5, 8, 11, 14, 17, 20. So, the number 47 is wrong and must be replaced by 46.
Subtract 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11 from successive numbers. So, 34 is wrong.
Prime numbers 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13 are to be added successively. So, 165 is wrong.
The terms are alternatively multiplied by 1.5 and divided by 3. However, 18.5 does not satisfy it.
The numbers are squares of odd natural numbers, starting from 5 up to 15. So, 36 is wrong.

Surds & Indices, Logarithm, Odd man out.question:
৬) Insert the missing number.(6-9)
16, 33, 65, 131, 261, (....)
Surds & Indices, Logarithm, Odd man out.exp: Each number is twice the preceding one with 1 added or subtracted alternatively. So, the next number is (2 x 261 + 1) = 523.
Go on multiplying the given numbers by 2, 3, 4, 5, 6. So, the correct next number is 1440.
Each number is the proceeding number multiplied by -2. So, the required number is -128.
Each number is double the preceding one plus 1. So, the next number is (255 x 2) + 1 = 511.
Each of the numbers except 72 is a perfect square.
The pattern is 12, 22, 32, 42, 52, 62, 72. But, instead of 52, it is 20 which to be turned out.
In each number except 383, the product of first and third digits is the middle one.
Each of the numbers except 81 is a prime number.

Surds & Indices, Logarithm, Odd man out.question: ১৪) Find the value of (3log2+2log3) / (2log6+log2)
Surds & Indices, Logarithm, Odd man out.exp:
3log2+2log3
=log23+log32
=log8+log9
=log(8×9)
=log72

2log6+log2
=log62+log2
=log36+log2
=log72

3log2+2log3 / 2log6+log2
=log72 / log72
= 1
